Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
古代的时候，一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了，可是有的吃了以后很舒服。他找很多植物。凉山很大的山，这也找植物。一天，他找到黄色的花。他听说你跟黄色的花做茶很有用。比方说，你的头发疼死，这冰茶是药。他一喝茶就很不舒服。

This scene:
糟糕，这黄色的花是夹竹桃，特别是毒。正好在这儿，灵芝药的夹竹桃他吃完了，也写一个课文的植物。谢谢神农。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. Add how Shennong feels after eating the poisonous flower, such as strong stomach pain and fear. e.g. 神农肚子很疼，难受得不得了。
2. Add a small detail about the helpful plant: it looks like an umbrella and helps him feel better quickly. e.g. 他吃了像伞一样的灵芝，很快好多了。
3. Add a short thank-you sentence from Shennong to the man who helps him. e.g. 神农说：“谢谢你，你救了我！”

ideas.reason: It adds a fitting concrete reaction to the poison that the learner has not yet stated.
It adds a concrete description of the lingzhi and shows how it helps him recover.
There is no man who helps Shennong in this part of the traditional tale.
